repo_summary: ILO is an open-source framework orchestrator written in Python 3.12. It reads a system description, selects a YAML-declared analytical framework from a registry, executes the framework's typed steps by dispatching to sub-agent workers (a built-in ilo-core that calls Anthropic, plus ACP-based workers for Hermes and Claude Code), and composes a schema-validated structured artifact in Markdown + JSON. The agent loop is a coordinator with dependency injection — it does not own the LLM, the tools, or the conversation state. Major surfaces are a CLI today and Telegram + web planned. Frameworks are contributed via PR to a sibling repo (ilo-frameworks). The whole project explicitly inverts the philosophy of generalist agents like Hermes: instead of accumulating skills and lifelong-user memory, ILO produces reproducible artifacts pinned to framework versions, with per-engagement memory only.
